added: Radio voice now uses the Opus codec: about 4 KB/s per listener instead of 21 KB/s.
P25-style digital voice: radios or channels with digital = true in config/radios.lua (LSPD and LSSD by default). Voice.Digital in config/general.lua picks the profile (clean, mobile, weak).
Other players see your radio prop on every server, including sv_entityLockdown strict.
The channel cannot be changed while transmitting, and channel changes have a 150 ms cooldown.
changed: Voice audio travels as normal events instead of latent events. Crowded channels no longer sound robotic.
The voice host (DLL, Tunnel, External VPS) and server/voice_auth.lua are removed; no ports or domains are needed.
config/general.lua Voice section is down to the settings that matter: Quality, PTT.MaxTransmitSeconds, Scan, Bleed and MicPickup. An old Voice.Engine table is still read.
config/environment.lua siren presets are one line each (folder, warningFile, rumbler). Provider details are built in; old configs are still read.
Server and all players must run the same version. (For external voice-server users)
fixed: Changing channel or pressing radio buttons no longer restarts the hold animation.
Spamming volume or channel no longer makes the value jump back and forth, on handheld and vehicle radios.
A vehicle radio joining a channel you already hear on your handheld now shows the RX light and busy state.
Radio props now spawn on servers with strict entity lockdown.
A vehicle seat animation ending no longer cancels the handheld pose.
removed: Voice host DLL, Tunnel/External/GameServerIp settings and latent voice events.

added: RequireJob in config/vehicles.lua: vehicle radio voice follows the radio type's job, like handhelds (on by default).
Radio UI, PTT and props are put away when the player dies; the radio stays on.
If the handheld cannot transmit, a shared PTT key falls back to the vehicle radio.
changed: The voice host port only opens behind an https Tunnel or on the dedicated voice VPS. Without one, voice uses FiveM events and no port is opened.
External voice VPS: audio is sent in one batch per server tick, and players the VPS cannot reach fall back to FiveM events. Update the VPS and the game server together.
Voice host tokens travel in headers, never in URLs.
MaxRadiosPerPlayer is now enforced on every inventory.
Battery charge reported by clients is checked on the server.
ESX admin check uses the epsilon_radio.admin ACE instead of the broad command ACE.
Smaller UI bundle and lower CPU use in vehicles and while idle.
About 30% less voice traffic, far fewer state bag and channel list updates, and lower server CPU for speaker bleed and access checks.
Handheld radios used inside a helicopter now use the helicopter voice profile.
The unused native sound exports (playSoundFrontend, playSoundFromEntity and similar) are removed.
fixed: The radio UI no longer keeps re-rendering while the radio is off.
A slow or stalled listener can no longer freeze the server through the voice host.
One talker releasing PTT no longer cuts other talkers' audio.
Vehicle passengers can no longer transmit on the vehicle radio.
Dropping or stashing a radio on qb, lj or tgiann inventories now stops listening.
Reopening the radio right after closing it no longer locks the screen.
A different radio moved into the same ox_inventory slot ends the old session.
/setradio checks the job on framework servers.
Voice host streams stay open behind Cloudflare and reconnect with backoff.
Sound ids, vehicle radio states and bridge errors no longer leak or fail silently.
Unplugging the microphone stops transmitting.

changed: Bad or heavy voice traffic is less likely to flood a channel.
Voice network limits can be tuned in config.
In clothing rules, any listed piece is enough; colors and patterns can change the pose.
fixed: Using the portable radio from inventory opens the screen again.
Vehicle radio talk no longer gives a false busy click.
Reaching for a vehicle radio from outside no longer crashes the server.
Quick vehicle PTT taps are less likely to get stuck talking.
/radio_voice_reset cleans up and rebuilds voice properly when the mic breaks.
Letting go of talk no longer makes the next press feel late or doubled.
Quiet moments no longer make speech sound sped-up or robotic.
Word endings cut off less often when you release the key.
If someone drops mid-talk, the channel frees itself again.

added: Helicopter rotor bed mixes into PTT while in a heli (vehicle class 15), including handheld PTT from the cabin.
changed: Vehicle radios are configured as named types in config/vehicles.lua (layout pack + spawn model list + own zones), not a single global model/defaults block.
Siren TX beds use SirenPresets + VehicleSirenGroups only (no per-model VehicleSirens table).
Shared PTT key: portable wins while powered; vehicle only when the portable is missing or off.

added: Vehicle radio UI opens with a dedicated keybind and can stay hidden while voice stays connected.
changed: Only one person can key the shared vehicle radio at a time; the next press gets a busy response.
Cabin mic pickup is quieter for the seat beside the talker and much quieter in the back.
Outside a closed vehicle, nearby speech only barely reaches the radio and falls off with distance.
Portable and vehicle scan lists stay independent.
fixed: Scan listeners no longer appear on your selected channel list.

changed: Escape closes the handheld first, and restarts no longer auto-open radio UIs.
fixed: Portable and vehicle docks stop stealing each other's focus.

changed: The intentional radio delay stays in place without staff tuning.
fixed: Radio voices hold together more smoothly under pressure.

added: Vehicle radios arrive as their own class with power, volume, and channel memory.
Advanced opens with richer radio audio and separate device classes for portable and vehicle.
